g.text: Rhazes · Almansor in the manuscript’s page layouts
Distinct forms in the first and last 100 words of each page · manuscript shown in black
The same historical sequences and reflows as the earlier MATTR comparisons; each text retains its own word order.
Each panel is one bifolium. Page order: first leaf r/v, second leaf r/v. Solid: within page; dotted: next page.
* First/last 100-word samples overlap in the character-budget control on f81r (171 words). f116v has no assigned text.
